xBRIEFInfo.description: Ordered-plan continuation boundary so "next" cannot escape an approved sequence

plan.title: bug: continuation language can escape an approved ordered plan

narratives.Description: Add a deterministic ordered-plan continuation boundary so words like next/resume/proceed advance only within the narrowest operator-approved sequence and fail closed when exhausted. AGENTS.md stays pointer-thin (amend #1149 only); bulk lives in preamble, skills, and plan-sequence CLI/gate. Do not reuse triage queue continuation* fields.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator, when I approve a two-PR delivery sequence and say move on to the next task/pr, I want the agent to open only the next approved entry and stop after the last one, so continuation language cannot widen into the triage queue or adjacent backlog.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) packages/core/src/plan-sequence — token schema, store under .deft/plan-sequence.json, resolve/verify/advance/exhaust (separate from triage continuation*). 2) CLI: plan-sequence:set|current|clear|advance + verify:plan-sequence --target-kind/--target; wire route-argv + dispatch + tasks. 3) Amend agents-entry #1149 with 1–3 line ordered-plan precedence; expand commands.md Backlog Triage; add preamble ordered-plan section. 4) Pack/skill updates: triage (what's next plan-first), pre-pr target check, review-cycle exit/advance/stop, swarm/build cohort exhaustion; packs:render. 5) Content-contract + unit tests for two-PR next, exhausted fail-closed, no-plan→queue, AGENTS pointer-only. 6) CHANGELOG Closes #2402; agents:refresh; task check. Refs addenda on #2402 (phrase ambiguity, AGENTS budget).
narratives.Overview: Non-goals: raising agentsMdBudget.absoluteMaxBytes; collapsing into #2180 posture token; reusing triage continuationNumbers/continuationOrder; new multi-paragraph AGENTS section.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an ordered plan JSON, when plan-sequence:set/current and verify:plan-sequence run, then current entry, advance, and exhausted fail-closed behave deterministically without reusing triage continuation fields.

Given agents-entry #1149, when an ordered-plan context is active, then what's next binds to the plan first; triage:queue only on explicit queue/cohort ask or no active sequence; AGENTS delta is precedence-pointer only; preamble and affected skills encode full semantics.
Given a two-entry plan, when next after entry 1 resolves to entry 2 only and next after entry 2 fails closed; verify:agents-md-budget stays green without raising absoluteMaxBytes.
